verdict.rationale: Retell provides official Node.js/Python SDKs with typed clients and full API coverage, a documented CLI, and function-calling/custom-function endpoints, backed by public docs. This is strong first-party documentation for programmatic control, though there's no independent hands-on corroboration and no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s on probes). Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of SDK/API usage, publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec.
